newsitem.title: USA: Novavax completes private stock placement.
newsitem.headline: Novavax completes private stock placement.

text.p: Novavax Inc said on Tuesday that the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission has declared that its Form S-3 Registration statement for 505,000 common shares has become effective.
The shares were privately placed with institutional investors at $3.75 per share, the company said. Vector Securities International Inc was the placement agent.
Novavax Inc is a diversified pharmaceutical company that develops, produces and tests encapsulated pharmaceuticals, anti-infectives and adjuvants.
